paper.title: Hybrid convolutional neural network and PEPS wave functions for quantum many-particle states
paper.authors: Xiao Liang, Shao-Jun Dong, Lixin He

results.system_description: 10x10 square lattice, periodic; J1 = 1, J2 = 0.5; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.method: Deep CNN with a fixed PEPS sign prior
results.variant: D = 1 PEPS sign from J2 = 0; rotationally symmetrized deep CNN
results.source_location: Table I, p. 4 (row J2 = 0.5, column PEPS+D. CNN); repeated in Table II, p. 5
results.eligibility_evidence: Eq. (10), p. 4, defines Sign(W_PEPS) times W_CNN. The neural amplitudes are optimized variationally, with the fixed D=1 PEPS sign prior described on pp. 4-5 and rotational symmetrization in Eq. (11). The full PEPS amplitude is not a factor of this state.
